verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.semgrep.dev/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured index linking to markdown doc pages. The docs are served as agent-friendly .md variants (for-developers/cli.md, writing-rules/*.md) plus an _llms/ markdown path, so an agent can be pointed at clean, machine-readable docs. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration that agents consume these docs effectively, and no evidence of a full-content bundle (e.g. llms-full.txt) or agent-specific usage guidance.
